en: Black‑and‑white view of a hillside covered with trees, with a large villa in the foreground and a stone church with two tall, slender spires rising behind it. The villa has a steep tiled roof with dormer, half‑timbered gable, and balcony, characteristic of Central European architecture. The twin‑towered church has simple lancet windows and steep spires topped with finials. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the front.
